title: Run a per-repository setup command when a worktree is created
prompt:
A new worktree has no installed dependencies. Let each repository configure a setup command (Settings → Repositories → Scripts, stored locally, never read from repository files) that the runtime runs in a terminal pane when it creates a worktree for a session. Show its progress, keep a failed run and its log, and offer to hand the log to the agent.

Runtime (src-tauri): one `workspace_setup` command with an `operation`:
- `{ operation: "list" }` → every session's latest run.
- `{ operation: "rerun", sessionId }`, `{ operation: "stop", sessionId, paneId }` (stops that exact queued or running attempt), `{ operation: "log", sessionId, paneId }` → the retained output as a string.
- A run is `{ sessionId, paneId, command, status: "pending"|"running"|"stopping"|"stopped"|"succeeded"|"failed", exitCode: number|null, error: string|null, hasPane: boolean }` and is published as the `workspace_setup_changed` event on every change. A run that exceeds 30 minutes fails with exit 124 and an error saying it timed out after 30 minutes. Logs outlive the PTY.

Store (src/lib/workspaceSetup.ts, calling `invoke` from @/lib/api and `listen` from Tauri):
- Export the `WorkspaceSetup` type, `bootWorkspaceSetup()` (subscribe to `workspace_setup_changed`, `session_deleted` and `local_runtime_reattached` first, then list once; safe to call repeatedly), `refreshWorkspaceSetup()`, `useWorkspaceSetups()` (returns `{ runs }`), `useWorkspaceSetup(sessionId | null)`, rerun/stop/log helpers, and `setupFixPrompt(run, log)`.
- `useWorkspaceSetup(null)` (cloud tabs) must not contact the runtime or subscribe to anything; the first local session id triggers exactly one list.
- An event or deletion received while a list is in flight wins over that list's (older) result; a deleted session is never brought back by an old response.
- `setupFixPrompt` says the setup failed (with the exit code), asks the agent to diagnose and fix the cause, explains that the command itself is configured in Settings → Repositories → Scripts, and attaches the log between `<setup-log>\n` and `\n</setup-log>`. Strip terminal escape sequences and carriage returns from the log. Keep the prompt under 66,000 characters: keep only the last 64 KiB of a longer log, and say "Earlier output omitted".

UI (src/components/terminal):
- WorkspaceSetupPane.tsx exports `WorkspaceSetupPane({ run })`: a role="status" line such as "Setup failed · Exit 7" (statuses: Setup queued, Setup running, Stopping setup…, Setup stopped, Setup succeeded, Setup failed; " · Exit N" when there is an exit code); the live `TerminalView` for `run.paneId` while the pane exists, otherwise the retained log text; a Stop button for queued or running runs (it reads "Stopping…" and is disabled while stopping); a Rerun button, disabled while queued, running or stopping; the run's error or any action error in a role="alert".
- WorkspaceSetupNotice.tsx exports `WorkspaceSetupToasts()`: a "Setup failed" toast for a failed run with "Show log" (selects the session and opens the side panel's terminal: prefs `panelOpen` and `panelTerminalOpen` true) and "Ask agent to fix", which sends `setupFixPrompt` with the cleaned log to the session's active tab through the local session backend's `send(tabId, text, [])` only when clicked, then dismisses the toast. If the send is refused, show the error in a role="alert" and keep Show log.
- Show the setup pane in the terminal dock, and add the command field to the repository Scripts settings.
notes: Modules touched by the change: src-tauri (workspace_setup runner, PTY, local runtime calls, session ops), src/lib (setup store), src/components/terminal, settings and composer. Check: vitest, 2.6 s failing at the start, 2.4 s passing measured by check-task on 2026-11-12 (a fresh pnpm install adds 8 to 17 s; a cached one about 1 s). Start is the merge's first parent; solution is the merge commit.
